market_brief: The AI unwind is spreading into Europe: the STOXX 600 and DAX were down about 1% by mid-morning on the new US chip curbs, with Deutsche Bank down 5-6% after an FT report on Epstein-linked payments. US futures were off ~0.4% after Monday's S&P 500 -1.9% / SOX -5.3% rout. Nvidia is down ~39% from its October high, and BofA puts a 10-15% chance on guidance being pulled while it has an interim CEO, so tonight's print (~$109B consensus) is the main risk event. India stood out again: Sensex +0.5% and Bank Nifty at a record, with FIIs net buyers of ~Rs 4,865 cr as Brent held near $92. Rates are the second headwind. The 10Y is ~5.11%, a December Fed hike is ~91% priced with some 50bp risk ahead of Waller, and gold (+0.6%) and silver (+1.3%) are only bouncing modestly while BTC is stuck near $65k.
ai_brief: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max as a closed-weights model at $1.50/$4.50 per M tokens, breaking with Qwen's open-weights tradition. Apple is adding daily caps on server-side Apple Intelligence in its 27.3 betas, and OpenAI moved computer-use agents into healthcare workflows. AMD closed its ~$8.2B World Labs deal. Nvidia's results tonight and Anthropic's IPO pricing Wednesday remain the sentiment tests for AI stocks.

items.headline: European stocks fall ~1% as US chip curbs extend the AI selloff
items.summary: By mid-morning the STOXX 600 was down 0.9%, the Euro Stoxx 50 and DAX about 1.0%, and the FTSE 100 0.8%, led by tech and banks. US index futures were down roughly 0.3-0.4%.

items.headline: Deutsche Bank drops ~5-6% after FT report on leaked Epstein-related documents
items.summary: The shares fell sharply at the open after the Financial Times reportedly cited leaked documents on about $582M of suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein. It was the biggest drag on European banks.

items.headline: Update on Nvidia: BofA sees 10-15% chance guidance is withdrawn under interim CEO
items.summary: New ahead of tonight's report (consensus EPS $2.47 on ~$108.9B revenue): BofA flags a 10-15% chance Nvidia withholds guidance until a permanent CEO replaces Jensen Huang, who resigned Nov 12. The stock is ~39% below its October record.

items.headline: Options imply a ~$300B+ swing in Nvidia's market value after results
items.summary: Per Reuters, options pricing implies a post-earnings move worth about $335B in market value. CNBC notes Nvidia has already shed about $2 trillion from its peak.

items.headline: Home Depot Q3: sales $43.4B (+4.9%), adj. EPS $3.86; shares slip premarket
items.summary: Comparable sales rose 2.2% as average ticket offset slightly lower transactions. FY26 guidance is now ~4.5% sales growth and ~2% adjusted EPS growth, and Richard McPhail takes over as CEO from Ted Decker on Nov 23.

items.headline: Disney revenue up 16% to ~$25.9B; targets ~$3B of cost savings by FY2029
items.summary: Disney reported before the bell, and the stock was roughly flat to slightly higher in early trading.

items.headline: JD.com Q3 revenue +3.5% to RMB309.6B; non-GAAP net income +44%
items.summary: Operating income swung to RMB5.2B from a year-earlier loss, and diluted EPS per ADS rose 35%. The release did not announce a new buyback.

items.headline: Fedspeak day: Musalem, Waller, Hammack, Williams with a December hike ~91% priced
items.summary: Waller (14:10 GMT) has said he backs a 25bp December hike and would consider 50bp if inflation surprises, and markets price ~9% odds of 50bp. Williams (19:25 GMT) has argued for further tightening.

items.headline: ZEW beats: German expectations 35.6 vs 29 expected; eurozone 26.5 vs 19.1
items.summary: Investor sentiment improved more than forecast, but the euro still slipped against sterling and the dollar.

items.headline: UK unemployment falls to 4.6% vs 4.7% expected
items.summary: A firmer labour market makes a near-term BoE cut harder to argue for ahead of Wednesday's CPI release.

items.headline: Update: Sensex +427 to 82,532, Nifty 25,387; Bank Nifty closes at a record 62,273
items.summary: India extended its gains for a second day as PSU banks (+2%) and realty led and IT lagged (-0.9%). FIIs were net buyers of ~Rs 4,865 cr and DIIs net sellers of ~Rs 3,519 cr, while breadth was slightly negative.

items.headline: US futures slip ~0.4% after Monday's third straight loss
items.summary: Monday was the Nasdaq's worst day since Nov 5. Disney, Home Depot, JD.com and Klarna report today ahead of Nvidia after the close.

items.headline: Take-Two +2.5% premarket before Thursday's GTA VI launch; Nvidia's 13F shows larger SpaceX stake
items.summary: Nvidia's filing shows about 130.5M SpaceX shares (~$19.7B) at Sept 30 and an Intel holding cut by about a quarter.

items.headline: Prediction markets: Polymarket traders' November Nvidia bets in focus
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reviews Polymarket price markets on Nvidia after traders failed to anticipate October's drop.

items.headline: Bitcoin holds ~$65k, down ~13% w/w, as rate-hike bets weigh
items.summary: BTC traded in a $63.9k-$65.5k range overnight. Rate-hike pricing and Waller's remarks are seen as the near-term drivers.

items.headline: Biotech downgrades: Wedbush cuts Aclaris; Alumis hits one-year low after downgrade
items.summary: Small-cap biotech rating cuts were among Tuesday's notable analyst calls.

items.headline: Next 72h: US retail sales and Nvidia (Tue); UK CPI, Fed minutes, ANT pricing (Wed); ANT debut and GTA VI (Thu)
items.summary: October US retail sales come out today after gasoline drove most of September's 0.8% gain. China activity data and the PBoC LPR are also on this week's calendar.

items.headline: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max as a closed-weights model: 2.4T MoE, 1M context, $1.50/$4.50 per M tokens
items.summary: Alibaba says task costs are ~62% lower than its prior flagship. Independent scores reportedly put it near, but mostly below, frontier US models on agentic coding benchmarks.

items.headline: Apple adds daily limits on server-based Apple Intelligence in 27.3 betas
items.summary: Higher iCloud+ tiers get larger allowances, and Apple says more access will be available for a fee later. The betas also add Mac controls for AI agents.

items.headline: OpenAI brings computer-use agents and 20+ plugins to healthcare
items.summary: Launch partners include CVS Health and Cigna, and ChatGPT for Clinicians is free for verified US clinicians. OpenAI's own testing claims 99% of 325 EHR-inbox tasks were clinically safe.

items.headline: AMD closes ~$8.2B all-stock World Labs acquisition; Fei-Fei Li joins as EVP
items.summary: Li becomes chief scientist reporting to Lisa Su and will lead AMD's open AI research. AMD also opened the MI355X-based Lux supercomputer at Oak Ridge.

items.headline: Nvidia unveils DGX Spark HPC developer kit at SC26
items.summary: The kit is a four-node desktop cluster with 512GB of memory that Nvidia says can run models up to ~700B parameters locally using NVFP4.

items.headline: OpenAI expands ChatGPT for Academic Researchers to 200,000 researchers
items.summary: OpenAI is adding 50,000 new grants on a first-come basis, with applications opening Nov 23, after a pilot with 20,000 researchers.

items.headline: LVMH's media division signs ChatGPT Enterprise and content deal with OpenAI
items.summary: Seventeen titles including Les Echos and Le Parisien will appear with links in ChatGPT answers. Terms were not disclosed.

items.headline: Trending: AG-UI agent-to-frontend protocol and an FFmpeg skill for coding agents
items.summary: ag-ui (MIT, ~19k stars) gained ~800 stars in a day. kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill exposes 42 typed FFmpeg tools for offline video editing by agents.

items.headline: Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf, a lightweight non-Chromium browser engine for AI agents
items.summary: Apache-2.0 licensed, it runs on Workers or locally and supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

items.headline: OpenAI adds CSAM countermeasures, including 24-hour access pauses for flagged accounts
items.summary: The measures include an image classifier, warning screens and law-enforcement tooling, per TechCrunch. No reoffense data was published.

items.headline: Utilities including Duke Energy reportedly test Anthropic's Mythos for grid software flaws
items.summary: Per DigiTimes (paywalled), power companies are using the restricted model to hunt for vulnerabilities in grid software.

items.headline: Altman says the industry 'will be fine' after Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia
items.summary: Speaking at a Semafor event, Altman declined to say whether Huang should return.
